import numpy as np, pandas as pd, math, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import LeaveOneOut, cross_val_score
os.makedirs("provenance",exist_ok=True)

EIS=dict(A=0.62,R=-2.53,N=-0.78,D=-0.90,C=0.29,Q=-0.85,E=-0.74,G=0.48,H=-0.40,I=1.38,L=1.06,K=-1.50,
         M=0.64,F=1.19,P=0.12,S=-0.18,T=-0.05,W=0.81,Y=0.26,V=1.08)
KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,
        F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
# Wimley-White interfacial scale (kcal/mol, negative = favourable partitioning into bilayer interface)
WW=dict(A=0.17,R=0.81,N=0.42,D=1.23,C=-0.24,Q=0.58,E=2.02,G=0.01,H=0.96,I=-0.31,L=-0.56,K=0.99,
        M=-0.23,F=-1.13,P=0.45,S=0.13,T=0.14,W=-1.85,Y=-0.94,V=0.07)
PACE=dict(A=0.0,L=0.21,R=0.21,M=0.24,K=0.26,Q=0.39,E=0.40,I=0.41,W=0.49,S=0.50,Y=0.53,F=0.54,
          H=0.61,V=0.61,N=0.65,T=0.66,C=0.68,D=0.69,G=1.00,P=3.16)
PKA=dict(D=4.05,E=4.45,H=5.98,C=9.0,Y=10.0,K=10.0,R=12.0)
def q(seq,pH=7.0,amid=False):
    v=1/(1+10**(pH-9.0))
    if not amid: v-=1/(1+10**(3.55-pH))
    for a in seq:
        if a in 'KRH': v+=1/(1+10**(pH-PKA[a]))
        elif a in 'DECY': v-=1/(1+10**(PKA[a]-pH))
    return v
def mom(seq,scale,angle=100.0,window=11):
    w=min(window,len(seq)); b=0.0
    for i in range(len(seq)-w+1):
        s=seq[i:i+w]
        sx=sum(scale.get(a,0)*math.cos(math.radians(angle*j)) for j,a in enumerate(s))
        sy=sum(scale.get(a,0)*math.sin(math.radians(angle*j)) for j,a in enumerate(s))
        b=max(b,math.hypot(sx,sy)/w)
    return b
def feat(seq,scale,amid):
    return [len(seq), q(seq,amid=amid), mom(seq,scale),
            sum(seq.count(a) for a in "KR")/len(seq),
            np.mean([PACE.get(a,1.0) for a in seq])]

lytic={"Magainin-2":"GIGKFLHSAKKFGKAFVGEIMNS","Melittin":"GIGAVLKVLTTGLPALISWIKRKRQQ",
 "Cecropin A":"KWKLFKKIEKVGQNIRDGIIKAGPAVAVVGQATQIAK","LL-37":"LLGDFFRKSKEKIGKEFKRIVQRIKDFLRNLVPRTES",
 "PGLa":"GMASKAGAIAGKIAKVALKAL","Protegrin-1":"RGGRLCYCRRRFCVCVGR","Indolicidin":"ILPWKWPWWPWRR",
 "Temporin A":"FLPLIGRVLSGIL","HNP-1":"ACYCRIPACIAGERRYGTCIYQGRLWAFCC",
 "hBD-2":"GIGDPVTCLKSGAICHPVFCPRRYKQIGTCGLPGTKCCKKP","Aurein 1.2":"GLFDIIKKIAESF",
 "Pleurocidin":"GWGSFFKKAAHVGKHVGKAALTHYL"}
neuro={"FMRF":"FMRF","FLP-1":"SADPNFLRF","FLP-13":"AMRNALVRF","FLP-18":"DFDGAMPGVLRF","NLP-12":"DYRPLQF",
 "Met-enk":"YGGFM","Leu-enk":"YGGFL","SubP":"RPKPQQFFGLM","Oxytocin":"CYIQNCPLG","GnRH":"QHWSYGLRPG",
 "a-MSH":"SYSMEHFRWGKPV","NmU-8":"YFLFRPRN",
 "NPY":"YPSKPDNPGEDAPAEDMARYYSALRHYINLITRQRY","Galanin":"GWTLNSAGYLLGPHAV"}

NLP29="MISTSSILVLVVLLACFMAASAQWGYGGYGRGYGGYGGYGRGMYGGYGRGMYGGYGRGMYGGYGRGMYGGWGK"
pro=NLP29[22:]
full_proc=[("QWGYGGY",True),("GYGGYGGY",True),("GMYGGY",True),("GMYGGY",True),("GMYGGY",True),("GMYGGW",True)]
# Alternative processing models (sensitivity analysis)
models={
 "M1 full processing + amidation (UniProt model)": full_proc,
 "M2 full processing, amidation FAILS (free acid)": [(s,False) for s,_ in full_proc],
 "M3 cleavage only at the C-terminal GK (single long peptide)": [(pro[:-2],True)],
 "M4 partial processing: cleavage at alternate sites only": [(pro[0:18],True),(pro[18:34],True),(pro[34:49],True)],
 "M5 no processing: intact pro-region": [(pro,False)],
 "M6 signal retained (unprocessed full precursor)": [(NLP29,False)],
}
scales={"Eisenberg":EIS,"Kyte-Doolittle":KD,"Wimley-White(inv)":{k:-v for k,v in WW.items()}}

res=[]
for sname,sc_ in scales.items():
    Xtr=np.array([feat(s,sc_,False) for s in lytic.values()]+[feat(s,sc_,True) for s in neuro.values()])
    ytr=np.array([1]*len(lytic)+[0]*len(neuro))
    ss=StandardScaler().fit(Xtr)
    acc=cross_val_score(LogisticRegression(C=1.0,max_iter=5000),ss.transform(Xtr),ytr,cv=LeaveOneOut()).mean()
    clf=LogisticRegression(C=1.0,max_iter=5000).fit(ss.transform(Xtr),ytr)
    for mname,peps in models.items():
        p=clf.predict_proba(ss.transform(np.array([feat(s,sc_,a) for s,a in peps])))[:,1]
        res.append(dict(scale=sname,loo_acc=round(acc,3),model=mname,n_peptides=len(peps),
                        P_lytic_min=round(float(p.min()),3),P_lytic_max=round(float(p.max()),3),
                        P_lytic_median=round(float(np.median(p)),3)))
rb=pd.DataFrame(res)
rb.to_csv("provenance/nlp29_robustness_processing_models.csv",index=False)
print("=== Robustness: P(membrane-lytic) across 3 hydrophobicity scales x 6 processing models ===")
print(rb.to_string(index=False))

piv=rb.pivot(index="model",columns="scale",values="P_lytic_median")
piv=piv.reindex(list(models.keys()))
print("\n=== Median P(membrane-lytic), rows = processing model ===")
print(piv.round(3).to_string())

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9.2,4.6))
im=ax.imshow(piv.values,cmap="RdYlBu_r",vmin=0,vmax=1,aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(range(piv.shape[1])); ax.set_xticklabels(piv.columns,fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(range(piv.shape[0]))
ax.set_yticklabels([m if len(m)<48 else m[:46]+"..." for m in piv.index],fontsize=8.5)
for i in range(piv.shape[0]):
    for j in range(piv.shape[1]):
        v=piv.values[i,j]
        ax.text(j,i,f"{v:.2f}",ha="center",va="center",fontsize=10,
                color="white" if (v<0.25 or v>0.75) else "black")
plt.colorbar(im,label="median P(membrane-lytic)")
ax.set_title("The verdict flips entirely on the processing assumption, not on the hydrophobicity scale",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
